title: Joyful French Peanuts Terrine
description: A winey, springy terrine of roasted peanuts and beurre monte that makes a crowd-pleaser for any occasion.
instructions: Toss 2 cups raw peanuts with 1 teaspoon sea salt and spread them in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast peanuts in the oven for 12 minutes, stirring halfway, until they are fragrant and slightly browned.
While peanuts roast, melt 3 tablespoons of butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 cup dry white wine to the melted butter, whisking until the mixture is smooth and slightly reduced.
Once peanuts are roasted, transfer them to a heatproof bowl, pour the wine butter mixture over them, and stir gently to coat all peanuts.
Season the mixture with ½ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, adding more salt if desired.
Press the peanut mixture firmly into a greased terrine mold, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Chill the terrine in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving, optionally garnishing with chopped parsley and toasted almond slivers.
